transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting because we have 1,200 cast aluminum housings on hold due to cosmetic residue from the forming operation. Before I can authorize any rework and release the campaign plan, we need to go through our standard pre-authorization review. I'd like to hear from process engineering, maintenance, quality, and EHS on whether we can use the ultrasonic cleaning cell for this rework, and what inspection documentation we'll need before release. Let's start with process engineering — can you walk us through what happened and what you're proposing?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important finding from the process trial I completed yesterday. The trial showed that the residue can be successfully removed from only 900 of the 1,200 housings using the ultrasonic cleaning cell. The remaining 300 housings have embedded residue that cannot be removed by this method and must remain on hold. I have not yet entered this result into the production release system, so I wanted to make sure everyone here is aware before we proceed with the pre-authorization review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Before we go further, I need to flag something about the ultrasonic cleaning cell. During my weekly walkdown I found that the circulation-pump seal needs to be replaced before the cell can be used. It's a planned 4-hour downtime, but I haven't opened the maintenance work order yet, so we need to account for that in the campaign timeline.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something important from the customer control plan that I confirmed this morning. Every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning, and the plan requires exactly 30 reworked housings to be retained for customer review. I received the revised plan from the customer portal this morning, but I have not yet updated the local inspection instruction to reflect these requirements. We'll need to factor dimensional scanning capacity and the retention of 30 units into our campaign plan and inspection documentation before release.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share an important finding from my waste review for this campaign. The spent cleaning solution from this rework must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest. I confirmed the classification with our site's waste contractor this week, but I have not yet updated the area waste-board notice to reflect this requirement. We'll need to ensure the 2 totes are staged and the manifest is prepared before the campaign begins, and I'll update the waste-board notice as part of the release process.
transcript.speaker: A5
